35874-mr-punch-in-bohemia.title: Mr Punch In Bohemia
35874-mr-punch-in-bohemia.creator: Unknown
35874-mr-punch-in-bohemia.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Time was when Bohemianism was synonymous with soiled linen and unkempt locks. But those days of the ragged Bohemia have happily passed away, and that land of unconventional life--which had finally grown conventional in its characteristics--has now become "a sphere of influence" of Modern Society! In a word, it is now respectable. There are those who firmly believe it has been wiped off the social map.

42383-hugh-walpole-an-appreciation.title: Hugh Walpole An Appreciation
42383-hugh-walpole-an-appreciation.creator: Unknown
42383-hugh-walpole-an-appreciation.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. retense, it must be made clear that my real concern is with the pleasure, the glow and sense of recognition, to be had from his pages. The evoked emotions, which belong to the heart rather than the head, are the great, the final, mark of the true novelist. And they may be, perhaps, expressed in the single word, magic.

arxiv-1603-05670.title: Bank distress in the news: Describing events through deep learning Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-1603-05670.creator: Samuel Rönnqvist, Peter Sarlin
arxiv-1603-05670.description: Abstract While many models are purposed for detecting the occurrence of significant events in financial systems, the task of providing qualitative detail on the developments is not usually as well automated. We present a deep learning approach for detecting relevant discussion in text and extracting natural language descriptions of events.

arxiv-1603-08516.title: A blow-up criterion for strong solutions to three-dimensional compressible magnetohydrodynamic equations
arxiv-1603-08516.creator: Xin Zhong
arxiv-1603-08516.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Xin Zhong. We are concerned with an initial boundary value problem for the compressible magnetohydrodynamic equations with viscosity depending on the density. It is shown that for the initial density away from vacuum, the strong solution to the problem exists globally if the gradient of velocity satisfies ‖ ∇ 𝐮 ‖ L 2 ​ ( 0 , T , L ∞ ) < ∞ \|\nabla\mathbf{u}\|_{L^{2}(0,T;L^{\infty})}<\infty . Our method relies upon the delicate energy estimates and elliptic estimates.

arxiv-1910-02456.title: Ground-State Phase Diagram of an Anisotropic 𝑺 = 𝟏 S=1 Ferromagnetic-Antiferromagnetic Bond-Alternating Chain
arxiv-1910-02456.creator: Kiyomi Okamoto 1 , Takashi Tonegawa 2,3 , Makoto Kaburagi 2 and Tôru Sakai 1,4
arxiv-1910-02456.description: Abstract By using mainly numerical methods, we investigate the ground-state phase diagram (GSPD) of an S = 1 S=1 ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic bond-alternating chain with the X ​ X ​ Z XXZ and the on-site anisotropies. This system can be mapped onto an anisotropic spin-2 chain when the ferromagnetic interaction is much stronger than the antiferromagnetic interaction.

arxiv-1911-09041.title: Talking datasets – understanding data sensemaking behaviours Journal: International Journal of Human Computer Studies
arxiv-1911-09041.creator: Laura Koesten*, Kathleen Gregory*, Paul Groth, Elena Simperl
arxiv-1911-09041.description: Abstract The sharing and reuse of data are seen as critical to solving the most complex problems of today. Despite this potential, relatively little attention has been paid to a key step in data reuse: the behaviours involved in data-centric sensemaking.

arxiv-2109-07085.title: On isolated singularities for fractional Lane-Emden equation
arxiv-2109-07085.creator: in the Serrin’s critical case
arxiv-2109-07085.description: Abstract A challenging problem for nonlocal semilinear elliptic equation is the fractional Lane-Emden equation in the Serrin’s critical case. This is due to the various challenges and the lack of tools to analyze the isolated singularities. These difficulties come from the nonlocal setting where the ODE’s tools fail to provide useful information.

arxiv-2111-12361.title: The Carina High-contrast Imaging Project for massive Stars (CHIPS)
arxiv-2111-12361.creator: A. Rainot, M. Reggiani, H. Sana, J. Bodensteiner, O. Absil ,
arxiv-2111-12361.description: Abstract Context. Most massive stars belong to multiple systems, yet the formation process leading to such high multiplicity remain insufficiently understood. To help constrain the different formation scenarios that exist, insights on the low-mass end of the companion mass function of such stars is crucial.

arxiv-2112-09717.title: Incorporating the weak mixing angle dependence to reconcile the neutron skin measurement on Pb 𝟐𝟎𝟖 \mathbf{{}^{208}\mathrm{Pb}} by PREX-II
arxiv-2112-09717.creator: M. Atzori Corona, M. Cadeddu, N. Cargioli, P. Finelli, M. Vorabbi
arxiv-2112-09717.description: Abstract The only available electroweak measurement of the Pb 208 {}^{208}\mathrm{Pb} neutron skin, Δ ​ R np \Delta R_{\rm{np}} , performed by the PREX-II Collaboration through polarized electron-lead scattering, shows a mild tension with respect to both the theoretical nuclear-model predictions and a host of measurements.

arxiv-2208-03748.title: Fourier analysis in spaces of shifts
arxiv-2208-03748.creator: A. Yu. Ulitskaya
arxiv-2208-03748.description: Abstract . In this paper, we develop a continual analog of decomposition over orthogonal bases in spaces generated by equidistant shifts of a single function. By doing so, we obtain an explicit expression for best approximation by spaces of shifts in L 2 ​ ( ℝ ) L_{2}(\mathbb{R}) .

arxiv-2208-04662.title: Max-Planck-Institut für Physik (Werner Heisenberg Institut),
arxiv-2208-04662.creator: Föhringer Ring 6, 80805 München, Germany
arxiv-2208-04662.description: Abstract MPP-2022-100 Poisson-Lie T-duality defects and target space fusion Saskia Demulder and Thomas Raml Abstract. Topological defects have long been known to encode symmetries and dualities between physical systems. In the context of string theory, defects have been intensively studied at the level of the worldsheet.

arxiv-2209-15603.title: Modeling dispersive silver in the electrodynamic lattice-Boltzmann method using complex-conjugate pole-residue pairs
arxiv-2209-15603.creator: Cael Warner, Loïc Markley, Kenneth J. Chau
arxiv-2209-15603.description: Abstract The polarization density of a broadband electrodynamic lattice-Boltzmann method (ELBM) is generalized to represent frequency-dispersion of materials interacting with electromagnetic waves. The frequency-dependent refractive index and extinction coefficient are modeled using complex-conjugate pole-residue pairs in an auxiliary-differential-equation (ADE). Electric and magnetic fields are evaluated on a single lattice, ensuring a stable numerical solution up to the Nyquist limit.

arxiv-2304-03529.title: Interior pointwise C 1 , α C^{1,\alpha} estimates for Stokes systems in divergence form Note: Research supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [grant 12001419 and grant 12071365] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [grant xzy012022004].
arxiv-2304-03529.creator: Rong Dong, Dongsheng Li
arxiv-2304-03529.description: Abstract Interior pointwise C 1 , α C^{1,\alpha} estimates are established for Stokes systems in divergence form where no continuity in time variable is assumed for the coefficients and the given data. The estimates are attained by iteration and are presented by Campanato’s characterization. The sharpness of the conclusions can be seen from Serrin’s counterexample.

arxiv-2412-07686.title: Optimizing Sensor Redundancy in Sequential Decision-Making Problems
arxiv-2412-07686.creator: Jonas Nüßlein 1 , Maximilian Zorn 1 , Fabian Ritz 1 , Jonas Stein 1 , Gerhard Stenzel 1 , Julian Schönberger 1 , Thomas Gabor 1 and Claudia Linnhoff-Popien 1 1 Institute of Computer Science, LMU Munich, Germany jonas.nuesslein@ifi.lmu.de
arxiv-2412-07686.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies are designed to predict actions based on current observations to maximize cumulative future rewards. In real-world applications (i.e., non-simulated environments), sensors are essential for measuring the current state and providing the observations on which RL policies rely to make decisions.

arxiv-2412-18268.title: Optimality Conditions for Model Predictive Control: Rethinking Predictive Model Design
arxiv-2412-18268.creator: Akhil S Anand, Arash Bahari Kordabad, Mario Zanon, Sebastien Gros
arxiv-2412-18268.description: Abstract Optimality is a critical aspect of Model Predictive Control (MPC), especially in economic MPC. However, achieving optimality in MPC presents significant challenges, and may even be impossible, due to inherent inaccuracies in the predictive models. Predictive models often fail to accurately capture the true system dynamics, such as in the presence of stochasticity, leading to suboptimal MPC policies.

arxiv-2504-15252.title: SuoiAI: Building a Dataset for Aquatic Invertebrates in Vietnam
arxiv-2504-15252.creator: Tue Vo, Lakshay Sharma, Tuan Dinh, Khuong Dinh, Trang Nguyen, Trung Phan, Minh Do, Duong Vu
arxiv-2504-15252.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tue Vo, Lakshay Sharma, Tuan Dinh, Khuong Dinh, Trang Nguyen, Trung Phan, Minh Do, Duong Vu. Understanding and monitoring aquatic biodiversity is critical for ecological health and conservation efforts. This paper proposes SuoiAI, an end-to-end pipeline for building a dataset of aquatic invertebrates in Vietnam and employing machine learning (ML) techniques for species classification. We outline the methods for data collection, annotation, and model training, focusing on reducing annotation effort through semi-supervised learning and leveraging state-of-the-art object detection and classification models.

arxiv-2506-07147.title: Packing tetrahedrons in edge-weighted graphs
arxiv-2506-07147.creator: Wanting Sun, Shunan Wei, Donglei Yang
arxiv-2506-07147.description: Abstract We prove that for all μ > 0 , t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \mu>0,t\in(0,1) and sufficiently large n ∈ 4 ​ ℕ n\in 4\mathbb{N} , if G G is an edge-weighted complete graph on n n vertices with a weight function w : E ⁡ ( G ) → [ 0 , 1 ] w:E(G)\rightarrow[0,1] and

arxiv-2601-17865.title: D-Models and E-Models: Diversity–Stability Trade-offs in the Sampling Behavior of Large Language Models Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026; April 13–17, 2026; Dubai, United Arab Emirates Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW ’26), April 13–17, 2026, Dubai, United Arab E
arxiv-2601-17865.creator: Jia Gu, Liang Pang*, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
arxiv-2601-17865.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jia Gu, Liang Pang*, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng. The predictive probability of the next token ( P token P_{\text{token}} ) in large language models (LLMs) is inextricably linked to the probability of relevance for the next piece of information, the purchase probability of the next product, and the execution probability of the next action—all of which fall under the scope of the task-level target distribution ( P task P_{\text{task}} ).

europmc-pmc5964457.title: Virtual reality in the assessment, understanding, and treatment of mental health disorders.
europmc-pmc5964457.creator: Freeman D, Reeve S, Robinson A, Ehlers A, Clark D, Spanlang B, Slater M.
europmc-pmc5964457.description: Mental health problems are inseparable from the environment. With virtual reality (VR), computer-generated interactive environments, individuals can repeatedly experience their problematic situations and be taught, via evidence-based psychological treatments, how to overcome...

plos-pone-0344980.title: Federated high order tensor fusion for privacy preserving multimodal social media analysis
plos-pone-0344980.creator: Li Wan, Bin Zhang
plos-pone-0344980.description: Federated high order tensor fusion for privacy preserving multimodal social media analysis

pmc-10650681.title: Adhesive Capsulitis of the Ankle (Frozen Ankle): An Infrequent Syndrome
pmc-10650681.creator: Daniel Aguilar-Núñez, Dina Hamed-Hamed, María Aguilar-García, María Cuevas-Cervera, José Javier Pérez-Montilla, Ana González-Muñoz, Leo Pruimboom, Santiago Navarro-Ledesma, Elisa Belluzzi
pmc-10650681.description: Adhesive capsulitis, characterized by progressive fibrosis, causes a gradual, painful loss of both active and passive articular motion, leading to the final contracture of the joint capsule. The condition commonly referred to as “frozen ankle” (FA), which Goldman was the first to use, relates to the ankle joint and is challenging to both diagnose and treat.

pmc-11418578.title: VPS13C and STING expression in neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus: unveiling an unbreached territory
pmc-11418578.creator: Amany M Ebaid, Mohammad A Zakaria, Enas M Mekkawy, Rania S Nageeb, Rabab M Elfwakhry, Dina A Seleem, Marwa A Shabana, Marwa M Esawy
pmc-11418578.description: ObjectivesTo measure the expression level of the vacuolar protein sorting 13 (VPS13) gene and stimulator of interferon genes (STING) in patients with SLE with and without reported neuropsychiatric symptoms to establish their possible role in the pathogenesis of neuropsychiatric SLE (NPSLE).

pmc-11645101.title: An Investigation of Extended-Dimension Embedded CKF-SLAM Based on the Akaike Information Criterion
pmc-11645101.creator: Hanghang Xu, Yijin Chen, Wenhui Song, Lianchao Wang, Jesús Ureña
pmc-11645101.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) faces significant challenges due to high computational costs, low accuracy, and instability, which are particularly problematic because SLAM systems often operate in real-time environments where timely and precise state estimation is crucial. High computational costs can lead to delays, low accuracy can result in incorrect mapping and localization, and instability can make the entire system unreliable, especially in dynamic or complex environments.

pmc-11653829.title: Development of a thrombin-antithrombin complex detection kit and study in venous thromboembolism complicated by cervical cancer
pmc-11653829.creator: Yanru Qiu, Shuang Han, Yu Ji, Zhixian Lu, Xuan Huang
pmc-11653829.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveOur study successfully developed an assay kit for thrombin-antithrombin complex (TAT) and demonstrated the predictive value of plasma TAT concentration in the development of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in patients with cervical cancer.MethodA retrospective analysis was conducted on 177 patients with cervical cancer who received treatment at the Affiliated Hospital of Jiangnan University in Wuxi City from July 1, 2023 to October 1, 2023. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of cervical cancer patients and their VTE risk factors.

pmc-11709599.title: Epigenomics dysregulation and therapeutics in neurodegeneration
pmc-11709599.creator: Anne‐Laurence Boutillier
pmc-11709599.description: BackgroundAging is the main risk factor of cognitive neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s disease, with epigenome alterations as a contributing factor, however, it is not clear which biological mechanisms are common or disease‐specific. Here we investigated epigenomic/genomic signatures in the hippocampus of mouse models of aging and of tauopathy, an AD‐related feature.

pmc-12491013.title: An analysis of National Cancer Institute-funded scale-up research
pmc-12491013.creator: Cynthia Vinson, Aubrey Villalobos, Margarita Correa-Mendez, Gila Neta
pmc-12491013.description: BackgroundThe National Cancer Institute seeks to support cancer research to advance scientific knowledge that will “help all people live longer, healthier lives.” To do this, we need to understand how to effectively and efficiently scale-up evidence-based cancer control innovations (EBIs). We analyzed National Cancer Institute (NCI)-funded implementation science (IS) grants to understand gaps and opportunities for scale-up research.

pmc-12663515.title: Endophilin–lamellipodin–VASP, key components in fast endophilin–mediated endocytosis, control actin polymerization within liquid-like condensates
pmc-12663515.creator: Karthik B. Narayan, Honey Priya James, Jonathan Cope, Samsuzzoha Mondal, Laura Baeyens, Francesco Milano, Jason Zheng, Matthias Krause, Tobias Baumgart
pmc-12663515.description: Actin polymerization is essential in several clathrin-independent endocytic pathways including fast endophilin–mediated endocytosis (FEME); however, the actin machinery involved in FEME has been elusive. Here, we show that the actin polymerase VASP colocalizes and interacts directly with the FEME priming complex.

pmc-12787095.title: Exploring Evidence-Based Approaches to Ocular Allergy Among Australian Health Practitioners
pmc-12787095.creator: Ereeny Mikhail, Mohammadreza Mohebbi, Serap Azizoglu, Khyber Alam, Cenk Suphioglu, Moneisha Gokhale
pmc-12787095.description: Background/Objectives: Ocular Allergy (OA) has profound effects on the quality of life (QoL) and ocular health of affected individuals. This study aimed to survey health practitioners in Australia on their knowledge and practices regarding currently available evidence-based diagnostic, treatment, and collaborative care approaches to OA.

pmc-13249921.title: Monte Carlo simulations of optical propagation in human skin using experimentally measured laser parameters
pmc-13249921.creator: Carlos Eduardo Girasol, Raíssa Mendonça Quaranta Lobão, Murilo Sanches Sampaio, Luismar Barbosa Cruz-Junior, Rinaldo Roberto de Jesus Guirro, Luciano Bachmann
pmc-13249921.description: To simulate light propagation in human skin irradiated with laser sources emitting at 660 nm, 830 nm, and 904 nm, using different beam diameters and divergences, in order to characterize the internal fluence rate distribution profiles within the tissue. Monte Carlo simulations were performed using the GPU-accelerated MCX platform.

pmc-13401286.title: Two contrasting cases of adrenal insufficiency in adults: a case report
pmc-13401286.creator: Yingqi Guo
pmc-13401286.description: BackgroundAdrenal insufficiency (AI) is a clinical syndrome characterized by insufficient secretion of glucocorticoids and/or mineralocorticoids. The incidence of AI is low, and its clinical manifestations are non-specific, including fatigue, generalized weakness, nausea, and weight loss. Consequently, the condition can easily be misdiagnosed or overlooked. If not treated promptly, it may progress to a life-threatening adrenal crisis.

pmc-13476309.title: A Common Regulatory Architecture Shapes Queen Chemical Signals Across Multiple Exocrine Sites
pmc-13476309.creator: Margarita Orlova, Etya Amsalem
pmc-13476309.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Insects communicate identity, health, and reproductive state through diverse chemicals secreted from multiple glands and production sites. Although these exocrine sites often contain a similar profile of compounds, they are usually studied in isolation. Here, we tested the hypothesis that changes in the identity and abundance of chemical signals from different exocrine sites within the same individual are coordinated, suggesting they may be governed by shared regulatory processes.

pmc-13520271.title: Adult Fasciola hepatica in the rectus abdominis muscle: a case report
pmc-13520271.creator: Seyed Ali Hashemi, Mitra Shayeghi-Kelyani, Saeid Ebrahimi, Amir Bairami, Mohammad Zibaei

pmc-13579884.title: Cystathionine beta-synthase promotes anoikis resistance and transcoelomic metastasis in ovarian cancer via SP1- ITGB1 regulation
pmc-13579884.creator: Pallab Shaw, Arpan Dey Bhowmik, Akrit Pran Jaswal, Rameswari Velayutham, Srikanth Chiliveru, Samantha Ricketts, Chao Xu, Danny N Dhanasekaran, Zhizhaung Joe Zhao, Resham Bhattacharya, Priyabrata Mukherjee, Shailendra Kumar Dhar Dwivedi, Geeta Rao
pmc-13579884.description: Anoikis resistance is crucial for ovarian cancer (OvCa) transcoelomic metastasis, during which exfoliated OvCa cells survive as spheroids before invading the omentum. Here, we demonstrate that cystathionine β-synthase (CBS), an H2S-producing transsulfuration pathway enzyme, is a key determinant of OvCa spheroidal viability and metastatic potential.

pmc-13593343.title: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling in gastric cancer: orchestrating epithelial-stromal heterogeneity, plasticity, and therapy resistance
pmc-13593343.creator: Junsong Zhao, Curt Balch, Dipti Athavale, Yanting Zhang, Xiaodan Yao, Mikel Ghelfi, Madeline B Torres, Young Ki Hong, Jamin Morrison, Francis Spitz, Generosa Grana, Shumei Song
pmc-13593343.description: Gastric cancer is a lethal malignancy with highly variable clinical behavior, reflecting both inter-tumor diversity and marked heterogeneity within individual lesions. Large-scale genomics data (including TCGA and ACRG) has delineated recurring molecular subtypes, while expression- and immunohistochemistry-based schemes provide clinically practical surrogates.

pmc-13675935.title: Endothelial Matrin‐3 Limits Cellular Senescence and Lipid Dysregulation to Protect Against Murine Atherosclerosis
pmc-13675935.creator: Xiao Cheng, Fatema Yeasmin Tanni, Rachelle Nelson Zoni, Elham Abdollahi, Eli Childs, Xinghui Sun
pmc-13675935.description: Matrin‐3 is a DNA‐ and RNA‐binding protein implicated in cardiovascular development. However, the role of endothelial Matrin‐3 in atherosclerosis has not been previously studied. Here, we found that Matrin‐3 silencing induces endothelial senescence, characterized by reduced cell proliferation, increased senescence‐associated β‐galactosidase activity, and impaired mitochondrial function in vitro.

pmc-13680427.title: Nano-kinetic implant surface mediates osteo-antibacterial synergy through electromagnetic-mechanical coupling
pmc-13680427.creator: Yangmengfan Chen, Hao Du, Heng Sun, Xingcan Huang, Duan Wang, Xuming Chen, Jiehao Chen, Xuanjun Zhang, Liqiang Zhou, Zongke Zhou
pmc-13680427.description: Periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) is a devastating complication of total joint arthroplasty, mainly caused by bacterial biofilm formation and antibiotic resistance. Traditional static surfaces rely on contact killing-based bactericidal properties and cannot reliably clear mature biofilms. In this study, we fabricate a remote-activated dynamic biomimetic system, namely a movable magnetic topographic surface (MMTS).
